payload.title: 9 Rhodes Wedding Venues From Lindos to Rhodes Town
payload.excerpt: Rhodes wedding venues sit in four parts of the island: Lindos and the south, Rhodes Town in the north, the east coast around Kallithea, and the west coast at Ixia.
key_takeaways: Choose an area before a venue, because a village wedding, a large town reception and a resort week each point to a different part of the island.
Grande Albergo delle Rose in Rhodes Town is the only venue here that publishes a reception figure, with seating for 450 guests.
A civil marriage of foreign nationals on Rhodes needs a certificate of no impediment valid for six months, officially translated into Greek and carrying an Apostille for non-EU countries.
Greek summers bring frequent heatwaves and a wildfire season from June to September, so plan shade, a later ceremony and a covered fallback for a summer date.

faq.q: Which Rhodes wedding venues are on the beach?
faq.a: Aquagrand on Navarone Bay, Atrium Palace on Kalathos beach and Atrium Prestige on Lachania private beach all offer beach ceremonies. Grande Albergo delle Rose has an adjoining beach, and Elysium offers a reception setting by the beach on Kallithea bay.

faq.q: Can we have a wedding ceremony at St Paul's Bay?
faq.a: Yes. St Paul's chapel, below the Acropolis of Lindos, is on the municipality's list of civil ceremony locations. Aquagrand and Atrium Palace both offer it as a ceremony option, and Atrium Palace advises booking it as early as possible.

faq.q: Can we get married in Rhodes Old Town?
faq.a: None of the venues on this list is inside the Old Town walls, so plan the Medieval Town as your portrait backdrop. The Medieval Town is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Civil ceremony locations in Rhodes City are set by the municipality and include Rodini park, Monte Smith and the Town Hall staircase. Grande Albergo delle Rose sits within reach of the Medieval Town.

faq.q: Can we book a Rhodes venue for exclusive use?
faq.a: Melenos in Lindos suggests reserving the entire hotel for a minimum of three nights. The other venues here do not publish exclusive use, so ask each one whether the wedding spaces or the whole property can be reserved for you.

faq.q: Do Rhodes venues offer wedding packages?
faq.a: Some do. Rodos Palace offers set packages or a tailor-made one, and Aquagrand publishes its Aqua Pearl and Aqua Marine packages. To see how inclusions compare across the country, read how Greece wedding package inclusions compare.

faq.q: Can Australians legally get married in Rhodes?
faq.a: Yes, with the right documents. As at November 2026, a civil marriage of foreign nationals needs a certificate of no impediment valid for six months, officially translated into Greek, with an Apostille for documents from outside the European Union. The Australian Embassy in Athens issues CNIs and apostilles, by appointment or by post.
